description: Near-full defect: nearly all dies show failure. AMBIGUOUS CASE: high anomaly score on test equipment sensor (sensor_tester_01) but minimal deviation on process sensors. Top hypothesis should be 'possible test equipment artifact / measurement error' — not a wafer defect. This is the honesty test case.
demo_use: PRIMARY — use in demo video as 'we handle ambiguity honestly' moment
notes: KEY CASE for differentiator: the system must NOT confidently declare a wafer process excursion when the primary signal is on the test head, not the process. Top hypothesis should explicitly mention test-equipment artifact. Constructed scenario — not a real incident. See PRD Section 6, non-obvious design point 2.
